source: flow_graph/plant_flow_graph.json node CRYO_O2 (graph revision AD); docs-authority/duties/CRYO_O2.md sections 3, 4 and 6; docs-authority/nozzles/CRYO_O2.csv; flow_graph/placement_seed.json; Generated by models/mfg/tracker.py (AQS-PLAN-006 section 6). Not edited by hand.
size_basis: L x W x H mm tube rack, set by flow_graph/param/receivers.py (A-M-167)

relief_basis.relief_mm_basis: governing of blocked outlet and fire case per half bank, rounded up to whole mm

design.material: SA-312 TP316L seamless DN100 Sch 160, B16.11 Class 9000 fittings / autoclave cone-and-thread, O2 bank cleaned to ASTM G93

material: 316L. Condensation. No carbon steel. Corrosion allowance 0 mm. Pit rate is not measured.

layout.frame: rack frame: x along 6696, y across 1500, z up 600; skid 12, SHS 80 x 80 x 5 posts and side rails, grooved tier combs, cross ties
layout.tubes: 16 tubes (14 main + 2 crew reserve) booked and drawn in 2 tiers (z 231/381) x 8 stations (y pitch 150); halves interleaved so each half carries 8 tubes (node fire case); crew reserve = the last slot of each half on the upper tier (2 tubes) behind a divider plate
layout.relief: one 9 mm API 520/521 valve per half bank at the +X end posts
layout.nozzle_spread: connections land on the side rails; schedule heights that fit the 600 rack are drawn as issued, the rest clamped (per-tag in check.nozzles_drawn)
layout.hardware_idiom: stubs lap the rails or skid so every union fuses; bbox = the A-M-167 rack envelope exactly

study.grid_basis: tubes per row 8, row pitch 150 mm and the rack allowances are the rcv_* drivers (A-M-167) - the tier grid is derived from them, not a study value
study.note: skid 12 and SHS 80 x 80 x 5 are study sections not stated by any authority (the duty names only 316L and CA 0 mm)
